docs.title: Tanking Enforcement: the 2027 1.01 Sweepstakes
docs.summary: Reminder to every bottom-dweller: draft order runs on Potential Points, not your record, so benching studs earns nothing but shame. Starters must be expected to play, empty benches are no excuse, and hoarding injured free agents counts as sabotage. Escalating penalties up to losing your earliest rookie pick. Lose honestly.

docs.title: Cease & Desist: Fielding Non-Participating Personnel
docs.summary: Formal First Offense Warning to a winless franchise caught starting IR and PUP players with no shot at a snap to sink its Potential Points. Starting Week 7: field players who will play, stop collecting injured guys, and acknowledge in league chat by Thursday kickoff. Sentient injury reports are not a valid lineup.
